name: smartware-procedure-replay-contract-v1
description: Pre-registered gates for the three-arm procedure-replay benchmark: A no-memory, B Smartware procedure + verification receipt, C full skill/manual. Thresholds are fixed here and must not be moved after seeing outcomes.

first_proof.description: Harness must fail to report Arm B distinct from Arm A when the memory lane is a no-op (fail-before), then pass with a real lane (pass-after).

correctness.description: Arm B test results non-inferior to A and C; exact results recorded; no test tampering.

utility.description: Arm B p50 turns <= 81% of Arm A AND p50 tool calls <= 60% of Arm A.
